params.title: DR Drill Plan: Primary Database Cluster - 2026-02-08
params.body:
# DR Drill Plan: Primary Database Cluster

**Scheduled date/time:** 2026-02-08T06:00:00Z
**Duration:** 3 hours
**System Owner:** Database Team
**Priority:** Critical
**Environment:** Production
**Last Test:** 2025-08-15
**RTO:** 4 hours
**RPO:** 1 hour
**Drill Status:** In Progress

## Objectives
- Validate recovery procedures for the Primary Database Cluster.
- Confirm recovery completes within the 4 hours RTO.
- Confirm data recovery meets the 1 hour RPO.

## Plan
1. Pre-drill checklist: confirm participants, approvals, runbooks, backups, monitoring, and rollback criteria.
2. Execute drill: initiate the recovery procedure, record timestamps and observations, validate service and data integrity, and capture issues.
3. Post-drill report: document results, actual recovery metrics, gaps, corrective actions, and owners.

## Meeting
Zoom: DR Drill: Primary Database Cluster
https://zoom.us/j/8627655388

## Contacts
System Owner: Database Team

## Exit criteria
Recovery is validated, results are recorded, and any follow-up actions are assigned.

messages.subject: Solar panel cleaning scheduled
messages.body_plain: Solar panel cleaning crew scheduled for March 8, 6 AM - 12 PM. Roof access needed. Please notify security.

messages.subject: CCTV camera replacement quote
messages.body_plain: Quote for replacing 12 outdoor cameras with 4K models: $18,400 installed. Includes 3-year warranty. Delivery in 10 days.

messages.subject: Contractor badge renewal — 5 expiring
messages.body_plain: 5 contractor badges expire this week. Please renew: M. Reeves, S. Chen, D. Kowalski, L. Morales, G. Thompson.

messages.subject: Conference room AV upgrade proposal
messages.body_plain: Proposal to upgrade 6 conference rooms with dual 75-inch displays and wireless casting. Total: $42,000. ROI payback: 18 months.

messages.subject: Elevator Maintenance Confirmation — March 5
messages.body_plain: Confirming elevator maintenance for Building A, elevators 1-3, March 5 from 6 AM to 10 AM. Please post out-of-service notices.

messages.subject: Updated material delivery schedule
messages.body_plain: Steel delivery rescheduled from March 6 to March 8 due to weather. 12 tons of I-beam stock. Will need crane for unloading.

messages.subject: Fleet fuel consumption report — February
messages.body_plain: February fleet fuel: 4,200 gallons. Average 14.2 MPG. Vehicle F-112 flagged for 22% above average consumption.

messages.subject: Inventory cycle count — discrepancies found
messages.body_plain: March cycle count found discrepancies in 3 SKUs: BOLT-M8x25 (-42 units), FILTER-HV13 (-7 units), GLOVE-NIT-L (+15 boxes). Investigation underway.

messages.subject: Lease renewal — Building D, Suite 400
messages.body_plain: Lease renewal for Suite 400 due April 30. Current rate: $32/sqft. Landlord proposing 4% increase. Suggest we counter at 2%.

messages.subject: Nightly Backup Report — March 2
messages.body_plain: All backups completed successfully. Total data: 4.2 TB. Duration: 3h 17m. No errors.

messages.subject: Fire extinguisher inspection report ready
messages.body_plain: Annual fire extinguisher inspection complete. 2 units replaced (Building B, Floor 3). Full report attached.

messages.subject: Building Management Alert — Zone 3 Humidity
messages.body_plain: Humidity in Zone 3 exceeded 65% at 11:23 AM. Dehumidifier activated. Current reading: 58%.

messages.subject: Work Order #WO-3847 Overdue
messages.body_plain: Work Order #WO-3847 (Generator monthly test — Building D) is 2 days overdue. Assigned to: Ruben Vasquez.

messages.subject: Monthly Access Audit — February 2026
messages.body_plain: February access audit complete. 3 badges deactivated (terminations), 7 new badges issued. No anomalies detected.

messages.subject: Network Switch Upgrade — Building A
messages.body_plain: Network switch upgrade in Building A completed Saturday. 48-port PoE switches installed on floors 2-4. No disruption reported.

messages.subject: New Employee Onboarding — Week of March 10
messages.body_plain: 3 new hires starting March 10. Please ensure workstations, badges, and parking passes are ready by March 7.

messages.subject: Re: Delivery Schedule Update
messages.body_plain: Confirming the updated delivery schedule: Tuesday/Thursday 6 AM - 8 AM. Loading dock 3 reserved.

messages.subject: Server Room Temperature Alert
messages.body_plain: Alert: Server room B2 temperature reached 78°F at 3:42 AM. CRAC unit cycled and temp returned to 68°F by 3:55 AM.

messages.subject: Safety Incident Report #SR-2026-047
messages.body_plain: Minor slip reported in warehouse aisle 7. No injury. Root cause: condensation from cooler unit. Corrective action: floor mat installed.

messages.subject: UPS Battery Test Results — February
messages.body_plain: Monthly UPS battery test passed. All 4 units holding full charge. Next test scheduled March 28.

messages.subject: Vendor scorecard Q1 results
messages.body_plain: Q1 vendor scorecards posted. Top performers: Granite Supply (98/100), Summit Maintenance (95/100). 2 vendors flagged for late deliveries.

messages.subject: Shipping label printer offline — Dock 2
messages.body_plain: Shipping label printer at Dock 2 went offline. IT dispatched. Workaround: using Dock 3 printer. ETA for repair: 2 hours.

messages.subject: OSHA Training Reminder — Due March 15
messages.body_plain: Reminder: Annual OSHA safety training must be completed by March 15. Log into LMS to access the module.

messages.subject: Racking system installation — Phase 2
messages.body_plain: Phase 2 racking installation scheduled for March 17-21. Please confirm aisle 12-14 will be cleared by March 14.

messages.subject: Compliance audit follow-up items
messages.body_plain: 3 items from last week's compliance audit need attention: chemical storage labeling, eyewash station testing, and forklift cert updates.

messages.subject: Security guard schedule — March
messages.body_plain: March security schedule posted. Added overnight coverage for the warehouse expansion project (March 15-31).

messages.subject: Preventive Maintenance Schedule — Week 10
messages.body_plain: Attached: Week 10 PM schedule. 14 work orders open, 3 urgent. Building C chiller inspection due Thursday.

messages.subject: Boiler inspection passed
messages.body_plain: Annual boiler inspection completed. All 3 units passed. Certificates uploaded to the compliance portal.

messages.subject: Vehicle #F-207 maintenance due
messages.body_plain: Vehicle F-207 (2024 Ford Transit) is due for 30k mile service. Schedule with Fleet Auto by March 12.

messages.subject: Quote for replacement HVAC filters
messages.body_plain: Hi, attached is the quote for 200 MERV-13 filters. Unit price: $24.50. Bulk discount applied. Lead time: 5 business days.
